form.description: Custom probe sequences will be combined with the human or mouse reference genome

ref.title: Reference Transcriptome
ref.description: Custom probe set combined with reference genome

images.title: Image File(s)
images.description: Dataset holding an image for each sample in the samplesheet, listed in the dataset's own samplesheet.csv under the columns sample and file (and optionally slide and area)

image_type.title: Image Type
enumNames: Single H&E brightfield image in either TIFF or JPG format

create_bam.title: Create BAM File
create_bam.description: Enable or disable BAM file generation. Disabling this will speed up the pipeline.

schema.title: Samplesheet
schema.description: One row per pair of R1 and R2 FASTQ files. Rows with the same sample name, such as one per sequencing lane, are combined into a single Space Ranger run with the image listed for that sample in the image dataset.

sample.title: Sample
sample.errorMessage: Sample names can only contain letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores

fastq_1.title: FASTQ (R1)
fastq_1.errorMessage: Must be a gzipped read FASTQ (.fastq.gz or .fq.gz) with no spaces in its name, not an I1/I2 index read

fastq_2.title: FASTQ (R2)
fastq_2.errorMessage: Must be a gzipped read FASTQ (.fastq.gz or .fq.gz) with no spaces in its name, not an I1/I2 index read
